name: Westfield Culver City
description:
Westfield Culver City represents a successful example of retail revitalization, transforming a dated shopping property into a contemporary, vibrant retail destination. Spanning over 1 million square feet, this shopping center underwent a comprehensive $180 million renovation that introduced leading national retailers, modern design aesthetics, and innovative entertainment concepts to the Culver City area.

The renovated property features approximately 172 stores including major retailers such as Target, Best Buy, and leading fashion brands including H&M, Coach, and Hollister. The property's design philosophy emphasizes openness, natural light, and contemporary aesthetics that appeal to modern shoppers seeking a refreshed retail environment. The addition of innovative retailers like Activate—the world's first active gaming facility—demonstrates the mall's commitment to experiential retail beyond traditional shopping.

The property serves the Culver City and greater Los Angeles market with convenient access to a comprehensive range of retailers and services. Modern amenities including free Wi-Fi, electric vehicle charging stations, and locker services reflect contemporary retail expectations. The mall's physical layout emphasizes walkability and accessibility, with clear sightlines and intuitive navigation that make shopping convenient and enjoyable.

Culver City's cultural significance as a creative community (home to major entertainment studios, production facilities, and a thriving arts scene) influences the property's character and tenant selection. The mall has successfully positioned itself as a contemporary retail destination that appeals to the area's creative professionals, families, and younger shoppers seeking modern retail experiences.

The property's renovation demonstrates the success of thoughtful retail redevelopment—investing in contemporary design, relevant tenant mix, and experiential amenities creates renewed vitality and traffic. Westfield Culver City has become an essential shopping destination for residents throughout the Los Angeles area.
